title: Example popup
content: This popup is launched from a link inside the grammar block's prose. A real Learning Object would use one for a glossary entry, a grammar aside, or a pronunciation note — anything that would interrupt the flow if it sat inline.
Modal prose is inline rich text, so it supports semantic emphasis, line breaks, links to other popups, and audio icons. Presentational tags are rejected at load: write strong and em, never b or i.
Audio icons work inline, anywhere in the prose: — that is a placeholder clip, not real course audio. Click it to play; playing a clip stops any other clip on the page.
Each entry in this array renders as its own paragraph, so the author decides where the prose breaks rather than the renderer guessing.
